lane.role: cheap-claude lane per operator rule (2 agy + 1 haiku)
lane.summary: All acceptance criteria met and verified. Guards pass (check_ladder_sha_cache.sh main test, self-test, check_ladder_provenance.sh updated and tested). Identity-keyed cache with ctime prevents staleness: a file changed under same path/size/mtime is re-hashed because ctime (immutable by users) changes. Key re-check after hash (line 959) prevents caching files modified during hash. In-run memo keyed by identity prevents duplicates. No edge case permits stale attestation: concurrent writes cause cache miss not staleness, corrupted entries rejected by sha regex, symlink races detected by ctime. Measured 1470x improvement (294.3s->0.2s) on lambda.

note: Same family as the author, so a width lane; the two agy lanes in quorum-PMAT-4131.json (gemini-3.1-pro-high, gemini-3.8-flash-high) are the independent votes. Combined: 3/3 PASS.
